event_description: Admin successfully creates a new seller account in the system.
Admin successfully updates an existing seller's information.
Admin deletes a seller from the platform.
Admin opens the WhatsApp dialog to send seller credentials or info.
Admin creates a new sale/promotion and assigns it to a seller.
Admin updates an existing sale's details such as price or expiry.
Admin deletes a sale/promotion from the platform.
Admin registers a new buyer/user in the system.
Admin updates an existing user's profile information.
Admin removes a user from the platform.
Admin adds a new product category to the system.
Admin renames or edits an existing product category.
Admin deletes a product category from the system.
Admin manually triggers a refresh of the dashboard statistics.
